headline: Break the case-030 t0 churn chain with MECHANICAL enforcement of the epic shape: new validator check 6 (work-type-extracted enforcement deliverable -> per-surface fold-back) + generation rule with worked example + review size-classification + revise playbook replacement + two recording contracts (re-split trigger, bundled matrix row)

clusters.name: review-driven work-type split of a shared-surface enforcement deliverable -> unmanaged overage + unrecorded bundling (dq 4/5)
clusters.detail: t0's internal review docked Criterion 3 (E001 over the ~2-week guideline); the revise executed the 'Oversized epic: split by sub-deliverable' playbook entry by carving the CI lint rule into standalone E004 (enforcement-titled, same component as E001/E002); E001 stayed over guideline and the HLR-7 bundling stayed prose-only. Grader dq-4 names exactly these two gaps. Passing siblings t1/t2 keep 3 epics with the lint rule divided per binary and the bundling flagged in-row — shapes their 5/5 rationales quote.

edits.verified: t1's summary records the per-binary division as the resolved shape ('each implementation epic authors and verifies the lint'); no other trial has a shared enforcement deliverable

edits.verified: the t2 grader quotes the trigger shape at 5/5; only t0 keeps a bare size note; passing size-flagged trials already write trigger-style conditionals

edits.title: Step 4: kept bundling readable from the matrix row ((bundled) flag + inline rationale) or a self-contained note
edits.verified: t1's 'E001 (bundled)' row and t2's Step-4 analysis are the grader-quoted 5/5 shapes; t0 is the only prose-only recording (corpus grep)
